Flying Ship (Japanese: VSバルジーナ VS ), titled VS Mandibuzz in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 540th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 16th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Mandibuzz (Japanese: フライング・シップ Flying Ship) in the VIZ Media translation and Flying Ship in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
plainText:
Flying Ship (Japanese: VSバルジーナ VS ), titled VS Mandibuzz in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 540th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 16th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Mandibuzz (Japanese: フライング・シップ Flying Ship) in the VIZ Media translation and Flying Ship in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
tells about his job as well as the that Colress has under his control.
Whitley agrees to tell Blake about the memory card, but only after they work to free Kyurem from Colress's control.
Blake and Whitley fight their way through the s protecting the machine imprisoning Kyurem.
Blake has Kelden destroy the machine containing Kyurem, only to find that the machine was empty.
Colress reveals that the machine has already absorbed enough of Kyurem's energy to power the Plasma Frigate and freeze all of Unova.
Colress has Kyurem Blake, Whitley, and Kelden, and then has the Grunts toss them into the ocean.
Colress reveals that Kyurem appeared before Zinzolin two years earlier because it was responding to the energy released by 's awakening, and that the opposite has also now happened.
Somewhere, , Zekrom, and the Light Stone fly through the ocean.
